notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.13 & 1.0.14
notes.content:
[u]Features : [/u]
[list]
[*] Now possible to create a Lua Script component directly from Lua ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/creator?id=createcomponentcomponents]Doc[/url])
[*] Easier removal of components via Lua ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/component?id=remove]Doc[/url])
[*] Added new string conversion functions
[*] New function to retrieve an element's bounds ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/element?id=getboundscontainer]Doc[/url])
[*] New Rect class ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/rect]Doc[/url])
[*] Added new functions for generating random colors/gradients ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/random?id=colororgradientinteger]Doc[/url])
[*] Elements can now be renamed using Lua
[*] Now possible to add the same value multiple times to a chart via Lua ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/chart?id=addvaluefloating-integer]Doc[/url])
[*] Improved mouse wheel handling in the Live Tab when the mouse is captured by an element
[/list]

[u]Bug fixes : [/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a crash with the cache system
[/list]

[u]Next update : [/u]
The next update will include support for Windows theme informations (dark or white theme, accent colors...)

Thank you for your support !

Added new functions for generating random colors/gradients ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/random?id=colororgradientinteger]Doc[/url])

notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.12
notes.content:
[u]Features : [/u]
[list]
[*] New Lua global [b]Path[/b] ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/path]documentation here[/url])
[*] New function [b]windows.getFileRender [/b]to retrieve a file thumbnail ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/windows?id=getfilerenderstring]documentation here[/url])
[/list]

[u]Bug fixes : [/u]
[list]
[*] [b]DockApp [/b]now correctly applies the given [b]ContentMargin[/b]
[*] Fixed crash when opening the Resource menu
[/list]
Thank you for your support !

notes.title: Infinite Widgets 1.0.11
notes.content:
[list]
[*]It is now possible to manipulate individual application volume ([url=http://doc.infinitewidgets.net/#/codebase/winapp?id=setvolumeinteger]documentation here[/url])
[*]Added lowercase variants for CPU, GPU, and MOBO
[*]windows.getAppFromProcessName(..) is now correctly returning a WinApp
[/list]
Thank you for your support !
